Properties.Name: FastChannels-fast/Trace agent session

Parameters.Description: AgentCore runtime session id, the correlation id of every tool call of a conversation
Parameters.Name: session_id

Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @log, coalesce(correlation_id, execution_arn) as correlation, coalesce(message, details.detail_type, message_type, type, eventType) as step, @message
| filter @message like "{{session_id}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

Properties.Name: FastChannels-fast/Trace asset

Parameters.Description: Asset id or ingest correlation id (the ingest execution name)
Parameters.Name: asset_id

Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @log, coalesce(correlation_id, detail.userMetadata.correlation_id, execution_arn) as correlation, coalesce(message, detail.status, details.detail_type, message_type, type) as step, @message
| filter @message like "{{asset_id}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

Properties.Name: FastChannels-fast/Trace program

Parameters.Description: Program name or SCTE-35 event id of one of its breaks
Parameters.Name: program

Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @log, coalesce(eventType, message, details.detail_type, message_type) as step, coalesce(programName, correlation_id) as program, @message
| filter @message like "{{program}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

Properties.Name: FastChannels-fast/Trace session

Parameters.Description: MediaTailor playback session id ([session.uuid], CMCD sid, aws.sessionId)
Parameters.Name: session_id

Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @log, coalesce(eventType, message_type) as step, coalesce(adsRequestUrl, message) as detail, @message
| filter @message like "{{session_id}}"
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000
